Reaver long gone west. He did not run. He LEFT you something: three of his sworn, Tartarian Raiders jaw-marked in the old sign, standing up out of positions they took hours ago. They have been waiting for exactly the kind of hunter a shrine sends. There is no way past them and no one here to talk to. Put them down, and the trail he left is yours to read.
